youtube_description:
When something goes wrong while programming your Somfy RTS motor, sometimes it's best to just reset it to the factory settings, so you can start from a clean slate.

Trouble shooting is often more difficult, so starting fresh can save you a lot of time.

You always need an RTS remote control to reset the motor.

All the steps are covered here.

For more information go to:
www.motorise.it for the UK
www.tubularmotors.eu for the rest of Europe
